title: MediCare — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Prescription Pad. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Prescription Pad (Roshita)
options.lineage: The Egyptian doctor's روزتة — ruled sheet, Rx mark, pharmacy stamp
options.thesis: Booking is a prescription: an explicit, trustworthy document that converts care into action.
options.viewport: A prescription sheet fills the hero: MediCare as the letterhead, the booking steps as ruled lines being written, a rubber-stamp primary action.
options.risk: Reads decorative if the 'hand' becomes chrome instead of the actual booking act.

raised.raise: The pen circle: selected cards circled in biro, visited struck through
The ruled column: hairline rules and tabular numerics for fees and times

options.label: The Appointment Ledger
options.lineage: The clinic's paper diary of open slots
options.thesis: The mechanism made literal: real open times written in the book, your name penciled into a slot.
options.viewport: The clinic's appointment book: pages of open times, a pencil in your hand.
options.risk: Familiar: the calendar-and-list register every booking site already ships.

options.label: The Film Cutting Bench
options.lineage: A film editor's select rail: perforated strip, punched frames, folded tape flag
options.thesis: The booking wizard as a film strip: steps are frames, state is a mark, the place you stopped is flagged.
options.viewport: A black strip runs the page; each booking step a punched frame, the current step a folded orange flag.
options.case: Competitive: state-as-a-mark is the wizard made legible, but a film editor's bench is foreign to this audience.

options.label: The Orienteering Course
options.lineage: International orienteering maps: iso colors, contours, a purple course over everything
options.thesis: Availability is fixed terrain; the booking journey is a numbered purple course riding over it.
options.viewport: Doctors and slots as mapped terrain; the patient's path numbered control-to-control.
options.case: Competitive on clarity: course-over-terrain matches wizard-over-availability, but a map is a niche object, not this audience's daily world.

options.label: The Hall Catalog
options.lineage: A convention's printed catalog: stamp-size thumbnails in a numbered hall grid
options.thesis: The whole doctor directory as one packed catalog sheet, selected cells circled in pen.
options.viewport: A folded hall map keyed to a dense catalog grid; your route circled in biro.
options.case: Declined: a foreign artifact to an Egyptian patient audience, and the grid is less clear than the rail; kept the pen-circled selection mark.
options.kept: The pen circle: selected cards circled in biro, visited struck through.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What doctor-booking ships: a doctor-list grid, search bar, and blue accents, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The familiar browse-and-book arrangement at full craft.
